name: SkullKnightmon: Mighty Axe Mode
xros_req:
DigiXros Requirements [DigiXros -1] [SkullKnightmon] x [DeadlyAxemon] 
When this would be played, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each one reduces the play cost.
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Knightmon] in its name or 1 [DeadlyAxemon] or [Nene Amano] among them to your hand. Trash the rest. Then, if DigiXrosing with 2 cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 4 or less.
